interpretation.label: manipulation_inert_or_unmatched

preconditions.name: ARM_SELECTION_OFF::multi_action_commits_present
preconditions.description: At least one cell of this ARM committed a MULTI-ACTION program. Gate (6) of the mid-execution conjunction requires len(remaining) > 1 -- carried over from V3-EXQ-839/844's identical precondition. EXISTENTIAL, both arms.

preconditions.name: ARM_SELECTION_OFF::decomposition_precommit_live
preconditions.description: Pre-commit decomposition evaluated at least once -- a zero means the decomposition machinery is not running at all, a config error rather than a finding about this run's question.
preconditions.control: BEST cell of this arm (positive control)

preconditions.name: ARM_SELECTION_OFF::midexec_decomposition_occurs
preconditions.description: At least one cell of this ARM shows decomp_n_decomposed_midexec > 0 THIS run. Unlike V3-EXQ-844 (whose OFF arm structurally could not decompose), BOTH arms here have the abort mechanism enabled, so this applies to BOTH arms.

preconditions.name: ARM_SELECTION_OFF::off_forward_pe_varies
preconditions.description: OFF-arm positive control: committed-trajectory forward PE must have non-zero variance across the whole run (world_forward learned something informative) -- else the DV is a degenerate constant. Mirrors V3-EXQ-816/844's P3.

preconditions.name: ARM_SELECTION_OFF::off_forward_pe_bounded
preconditions.description: OFF-arm positive control: forward PE must be bounded (no explosion / divergence in the online forward model).

criteria.name: C1_TASK_OUTCOME_IMPROVES
criteria.statement: On seeds where mid-execution decomposition fired in BOTH arms (matched-abort-rate pairing -- both_decompose_seeds), the paired post-divergence-window mean harm signal, restricted to FRESH e3-selection ticks, is LESS negative (less harmful) in ARM_SELECTION_ON (harm-aware selection) than ARM_SELECTION_OFF, by an effect exceeding 1.0 x SE over >= 2 paired seeds.

criteria.name: C2_FORWARD_PE_CORROBORATES
criteria.statement: Consistency check (non-load-bearing, carried over from V3-EXQ-844's established finding): on the SAME matched-abort-pair window, forward-prediction error is also lower in ON than OFF, i.e. layering harm-aware selection on top of the abort mechanism does not undermine 844's own PE-reduction result. Not a novel claim about harm-aware selection's own mechanism -- harm is the task-outcome DV this claim actually asks about.

interpretation.preconditions_scope_note: interpretation.preconditions carries the GREEN arm(s) only (ARM_SELECTION_OFF). The RED arm(s) (ARM_SELECTION_ON) are carried in full at top level under per_arm_gate.red, and their criteria are marked load_bearing:false + criteria_non_degenerate:false. The indexer's _compute_adjudication reads interpretation.preconditions FLAT and ARM-BLIND and returns precondition_unmet for the WHOLE RUN on the first unmet entry, so including a scored-out arm's failure here would re-vacate the green arm at adjudication time.
